rationale: Read all thirteen declarations and eleven embedded command controls against capability/action/outcome/reconnection implementation. Consolidate duplicate stop/status, preserve unique status timeout assertion, and replace expected timeout imported from the same producer with independently expected 20-minute public action policy.

cases.title: refuses on a runtime that does not advertise managed servers, before calling the action
cases.reason: Missing runtime capability refuses after one status call without action dispatch.

cases.title: reads an older runtime’s method_not_found as the same refusal
cases.reason: Older runtime method_not_found from action becomes the same incompatible-runtime refusal.

cases.title: needs --yes before stopping, and then calls the same stop the settings use
cases.reason: Unconfirmed stop makes no calls; confirmed stop forwards its own method/selector with independently expected 20-minute action budget and prints settled stop outcome.

cases.title: inline command control: stop without yes
cases.reason: Unconfirmed stop makes no calls; confirmed stop forwards its own method/selector with independently expected 20-minute action budget and prints settled stop outcome.

cases.title: inline command control: stop confirmed
cases.reason: Unconfirmed stop makes no calls; confirmed stop forwards its own method/selector with independently expected 20-minute action budget and prints settled stop outcome.

cases.title: forgets a server only with --yes, over its own method (P1-E)
cases.reason: Unconfirmed forget makes no calls; confirmed forget uses distinct non-stopping method with independently expected 20-minute budget and uncertain-running guidance.

cases.title: inline command control: forget without yes
cases.reason: Unconfirmed forget makes no calls; confirmed forget uses distinct non-stopping method with independently expected 20-minute budget and uncertain-running guidance.

cases.title: inline command control: forget confirmed
cases.reason: Unconfirmed forget makes no calls; confirmed forget uses distinct non-stopping method with independently expected 20-minute budget and uncertain-running guidance.

cases.title: fails the command with the refusal, so scripts see a non-zero exit
cases.reason: Actual refusal outcome rejects with public error code, host reason and exact refusal data.

cases.title: passes --force to an update, and reports a deferred one as unsettled
cases.reason: Deferred update rejects, force=false/true survive independent dispatches, and both requests use independently expected 20-minute budget.

cases.title: inline command control: update without force
cases.reason: Deferred update rejects, force=false/true survive independent dispatches, and both requests use independently expected 20-minute budget.

cases.title: inline command control: update forced
cases.reason: Deferred update rejects, force=false/true survive independent dispatches, and both requests use independently expected 20-minute budget.

cases.title: fails on an outcome a newer desktop added instead of printing undefined
cases.reason: Future host outcome rejects explicitly without printing an undefined success result.

cases.title: prints a readable status
cases.reason: Exact readable status preserves rollback/unverifiable context; merge default-timeout RPC assertion from duplicate later case.

cases.title: gives mutating actions a budget past the desktop’s own deadlines, and status the default
cases.reason: Remove repeated confirmed-stop/status invocations. Stop already checks the budget and status default-timeout assertion moves into readable-status case. Numeric liveSessions fixture had no output assertion or separate behavior.

cases.title: inline command control: duplicate stop confirmed
cases.reason: Remove repeated confirmed-stop/status invocations. Stop already checks the budget and status default-timeout assertion moves into readable-status case. Numeric liveSessions fixture had no output assertion or separate behavior.

cases.title: inline command control: duplicate status default timeout
cases.reason: Remove repeated confirmed-stop/status invocations. Stop already checks the budget and status default-timeout assertion moves into readable-status case. Numeric liveSessions fixture had no output assertion or separate behavior.

cases.title: reports a timed-out action as possibly still running, never as a failure of the action
cases.reason: Runtime timeout on mutation produces uncertain in-progress guidance instead of claiming action failure.

cases.title: reports what a restarting update left behind instead of failing on the closed connection
cases.reason: Injected closed update connection is followed after controlled retry by actual status interpretation and reports the new active version.

cases.title: reports an update the restart left interrupted as needing recover
cases.reason: Injected interrupted activation status after restart becomes managed_server_interrupted.

cases.title: restores changed state only with --accept-changed-state --yes, and its refusal names the flags
cases.reason: Changed-state refusal names recovery flags; acceptance without yes makes no calls; confirmed acceptance forwards true with independently expected 20-minute action budget.

cases.title: inline command control: recover refusal
cases.reason: Changed-state refusal names recovery flags; acceptance without yes makes no calls; confirmed acceptance forwards true with independently expected 20-minute action budget.

cases.title: inline command control: recover acceptance without yes
cases.reason: Changed-state refusal names recovery flags; acceptance without yes makes no calls; confirmed acceptance forwards true with independently expected 20-minute action budget.

cases.title: inline command control: recover acceptance confirmed
cases.reason: Changed-state refusal names recovery flags; acceptance without yes makes no calls; confirmed acceptance forwards true with independently expected 20-minute action budget.
